selection.basis: Target the 25 highest-priority unique remote image records currently generating image-health-unverified gaps, ordered by the freshest gap inventory priority. Use the repository image-health reporter against only these exact IDs.
selection.writer: single local writer; no delegated researcher required because this batch is a deterministic URL health check, not product-claim research

procedure.report_command: npm run --silent image:report -- --ids=<comma-separated frozen image IDs> --json
procedure.integrate: Persist the report date and every current resource URL/classification/status/content type to each matching data/images record. Only all-current-resource healthy checks remove image-health gaps; blocked, broken, wrong-content-type, or unreachable results remain explicit and preserve their gaps.
procedure.limits: Do not change image URLs, files, rights, credits, alt text, or buyer visibility. Do not inspect out-of-scope image IDs.

done_criteria: Run the targeted image-health report once and retain its exact JSON output in the dated batch results record.
Persist only URL-bound health-check metadata supported by the report, preserving nonhealthy and incomplete results as unresolved.
Run focused validation and the full npm run check gate once; do not rerun image:report after this batch's image health metadata edits.
Re-run the gap inventory and record exactly which image-health gaps were removed and which remain.
Local B60 batch only; no push, pull request, merge, publication, or production action.
delivery: Local B60 batch only; no push, pull request, merge, publication, or production action.
